insights.text: Statutory and underlying profit present distinct views of Nationwide’s earnings.
insights.reasoning: The reported £2,026m underlying pretax profit reconciles to £1,490m statutory pretax profit through £1m net income adjustments, £138m acquisition-related expense adjustments and £399m member reward payments.
counter_evidence: Underlying profit is an alternative performance measure. Neither profit basis establishes cash available for external suppliers.

insights.text: Nationwide reported £399m member reward payments; £127m integration expenditure is already included in underlying administrative expenses.
